annotations.title: ESG GHG Official Emission Factor Resolver (ISPRA/DEFRA/EEA)

description:
[Deterministic ESG GHG emission factor resolver. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Resolves statutory emission factors from official ISPRA, DEFRA, and EEA databases for Scope 1 (fuel combustion), Scope 2 (electricity market/location-based), and Scope 3 (business travel, freight, cloud data centers) activities, mapping output to CSRD ESRS E1 reporting standards.
Usage: Use this tool to convert corporate activity data (kWh, Smc, Liters, pkm, tkm) into certified metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent (tCO2e).
Returns: JSON object with { activityQuantity: number, unit: string, emissionFactorKgCo2ePerUnit: number, databaseSource: string, totalEmissionsKgCo2e: number, totalEmissionsTco2e: number, esrsE1Classification: object }.

activityAmountUnits.description: Numeric volume of activity consumed (Smc, Liters, kWh, pkm, tkm)

countryCode.description: Geographic jurisdiction for emission factor resolution (default: IT)
